FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Harmony Arts Academy specializes in providing comprehensive dance, drama, and music instruction for students of all ages and skill levels. Our operations are structured around a team of highly qualified instructors, all holding current certifications in their respective disciplines, ensuring compliance with local and state educational standards. We prioritize safety and have implemented operational protocols that include regular safety drills, risk management procedures, and the maintenance of facilities that meet all safety regulations. Our well-equipped studios are designed for optimal learning, featuring specialized flooring, soundproofing, and safety measures tailored for the performing arts. Additionally, we are committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive environment, with staff background checks conducted for all personnel working with minors. Our curriculum is regularly updated to reflect best practices in education and the arts, enhancing the learning experience for every student. By maintaining active liability insurance and conducting thorough annual safety audits, we are dedicated to providing a secure and enriching atmosphere for our students and their families.

Our school offers a variety of dance, drama, and music classes, and while many of our instructors hold relevant certifications, we also have team members who are passionate about the arts and share their knowledge based on personal experience rather than formal training.
